value.rationale: The absence of nonzero idempotents is an intrinsic finite-dimensional evolution-algebra property for the natural probability space of labeled weighted permutation structures. The exact arithmetic set of possible dimensions and its sharp decay exponent and leading constant answer a meaningful rare-event question for every fixed finite field, including the qualitatively different F16 and F64 support structures. This is not merely a numerical table or parameter re-labeling. It is explicitly limited to the new asymptotic refinement, not the known cycle law.
